models.scope: Main batch, including existing CLI/WSL and initial desktop runs
Final desktop continuation probe; user-selected default for subsequent validation

cost.scope: Recorded CLI and desktop validation attempts, including retained failures; excludes coordinator implementation and review-agent usage; not a bill.

retained_failures: Invalid Windows test permission parameters before harness correction
Cross-sandbox-identity write refusal; original identity succeeds
Unnecessary authority pre-read; corrected and retested
Redundant newly-created draft backup; corrected and retested
Native conversation tool argument-range error; recovered with legal arguments
Desktop old-session memory lookup and duplicate source read
First continuation revision reused prior-turn configuration; second revision reads current files
WSL DNS reconnections, with eventual actual completion

version_mapping.v6_to_v8: Only bilingual continuation instruction and its tutorial copies changed; affected continuation paths retested. New v8 Windows installation, resume and fresh task completed.
version_mapping.release_docs: Final result summaries, download links and evidence metadata do not change prompt/executor behavior.

privacy: No raw conversations, private paths, credentials, work specification or machine logs included.
limits: Finite tests, not universal or long-term reliability
Desktop retains global instructions and available skills; clean CLI evidence is separate
Native source conversations each have one original turn; not every pagination combination tested
Windows directory junction tested; file symlink fixture unavailable
Transaction replacement does not promise multi-file atomicity
Real projects validated only for basic adoption; private history excluded
